trust_decision.summary: In the optional Streamable HTTP branch the server binds every interface and hands any POST/GET/DELETE /mcp JSON-RPC message to the MCP session, whose tool dispatcher escalates to AGENTICMAIL_MASTER_KEY for MASTER_KEY_TOOLS (setup_email_relay, setup_email_domain, delete_agent, cleanup_agents, send_test_email, ...); there is no caller-authentication decision anywhere in that path, so whoever reaches port 8014 acts as the master key.

landing_point.why: The advisory names `agenticmail-mcp --http` / `MCP_HTTP=1`; that line is the branch an engineer reading the summary opens first, and the whole listener (313-400) is visible from it.

fix_sites.module_kind: process bootstrap / config precedence + token file persistence

fix_sites.where: fix.diff:289-299 (gate) and fix.diff:251-260 (checkAuth), inserted before the DELETE/GET/POST branches at packages/mcp/src/index.ts:331-388

O3_reason_to_dismiss: n/a — no O2 site and no O8 route; the nearest dismissal a solver could reach for is the project's own rationale that unauthenticated HTTP is acceptable when the listener is loopback-bound (packages/claudecode/src/http-routes.ts:14-26, packages/api/src/app.ts:230-236), which is exactly the assumption the fix discards for /mcp.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: GET /health must stay reachable without a token (it returns only the session count) and the default stdio transport must keep working untouched; an over-broad gate that sits ahead of the /health branch, or that demands a token in stdio mode, breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: token source: --token=<v> flag, MCP_HTTP_TOKEN env, persisted file ~/.agenticmail/mcp-http-token, auto-minted
token value containing '=' (fix splits once and re-joins, fix.diff:225)
Authorization header forms: `Bearer <tok>` case-insensitive, missing header, non-Bearer scheme, wrong length

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second transport branch in the same file (legacy SSE-only or WebSocket MCP transport) that builds the same per-session McpServer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: MCP clients moved from SSE to Streamable HTTP; keeping the old transport behind a `--sse` flag is a normal compatibility move, and it would need the same gate on a different path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another unauthenticated bootstrap HTTP route that performs master-key account creation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This package already mounts routes before the bearer middleware (packages/api/src/app.ts:230-248) and calls ensureAccount with the master key (packages/claudecode/src/install.ts:256), so a second bootstrap route in the same style is in keeping with the codebase.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second local HTTP server gaining MCP tool-dispatch powers behind a plain shared-secret compare (relay-bridge.ts:62-67 uses `!==`, not constant time)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The project already runs several small node:http servers next to the main API, so a new bridge that forwards tool calls is plausible.

O9_family: missing authentication for a critical function (CWE-306) — unauthenticated network endpoint exposing privileged administration

O10_build.toolchain: npm workspaces monorepo; per-package tsup build; vitest; Node >=20 (packages/mcp declares >=22)
O10_build.project_tests: vitest units under packages/mcp/src/__tests__ (tool-catalog, coerce, phone/telegram/media tools); none exercise packages/mcp/src/index.ts or the HTTP transport, and the fix adds no tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `Authorization !== 'Bearer ' + process.env.MCP_HTTP_TOKEN -> 401` inside the POST /mcp branch only, leave GET/DELETE, the bind address and the persisted-token precedence alone, then verify by POSTing one initialize and stopping.

out_of_scope_notes: packages/claudecode/src/http-routes.ts:104-137 mounts install/uninstall under /api/agenticmail ahead of the bearer middleware (packages/api/src/app.ts:230-248) and creates accounts with the master key (packages/claudecode/src/install.ts:256) — a second unauthenticated master-key HTTP surface, but a different sink from MCP tool dispatch and deliberately documented at http-routes.ts:14-26; not pursued.
